messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: state of triangular views in Eigen
parts:
Seems like it's still a work in progress (see below).

If we want to speed these operations up, we could start
contributing directly to Eigen. But efficient matrix
numerical analysis is a black art unto itself and I'm
not sure we have anyone qualified now or who wants to
do that deep of a dive.

- Bob

From their devs today:

----------------------------------
It's not possible yet to multiply two triangular views. One of the operands has to be a general full matrix.

Gael.
==================================
I can confirm that this is an issue.
Somewhat related is this bug which at the moment is only worked-around:
http://eigen.tuxfamily.org/bz/show_bug.cgi?id=879

Triang*Triang did not work in 3.2 either, it seems.

I think for 3.3 we should at least work-around this (similar to bug 879)

Christoph
====================================
The situation here is different because tri*tri never compiled (on purpose), whereas in bug 879 the combination used to compile fine and even worked fine in some cases. If the nested full matrix already contains the appropriate zeros it is currently better to the user drop the triangularView decorator rather than copying it to a temporary.

gael
